title: BOUNCE RATE OSCILLOGRAM — green line follows the circle. Red follows in null space. Blue splits on transition.
summary: The green waveform on the globe IS the bounce rate — it's both seismic activity AND a human heartbeat oscillogram. Goal: keep the green line along the green circle ring. The red core tries to follow in the null space between. When red turns to green, blue should split — that's the elastic cold-snap, the up-down. The transition point IS the scalpel.

green_line.is: Bounce rate — seismic activity + human heartbeat oscillogram
green_line.goal: Keep it aligned with the green ring (the equator of health)
green_line.meaning: When the waveform hugs the circle = STABLE. When it diverges = SEISMIC.

red_core.what: The red glow at center (Gaia's heart)
red_core.is: Following in the null space between the green oscillations
red_core.goal: Red tracks the ENVELOPE of the green waveform
red_core.meaning: Red = heat = activity = current state. Chasing the rhythm.

blue_split.is: The elastic cold-snap. The up-down. The moment of phase change.
blue_split.trigger: When red turns to green = the transition = blue splits out
blue_split.meaning: Blue = the COLD side. Green = the warm/alive side. Split = crystallization.

the_physics.heartbeat: It's also a heartbeat — systole (compression) and diastole (expansion)

the_physics.elastic: The blue cold-snap = when the system snaps from one state to another
the_physics.oscillogram: Not a spectrogram (frequency) — an oscillogram (amplitude over time)

the_octave_of_light.20_80_to_20_20: The flaw was never out there. It was the lens. 20/80 vision → 20/20 = calibrate the observer, not the observed.
